hypotheses.persona: Single working adult with a standard 9-to-5 routine
hypotheses.rationale: Weekday pattern remains strong, but Saturday shows a relaxed start (coffee at table at 07:05, no departure of work items) and a later dinner (plate at 18:26). The consistent bedtime (phone at 22:10) suggests a regular sleep schedule even on weekends.

The Saturday events (no departure of keys/laptop/phone) could indicate a remote worker who only goes to the office on weekdays. However, the weekday pattern is very fixed, making this less likely than a standard office worker.
The weekday departures of work items are still strong evidence against this. Saturday's relaxed morning (coffee at table at 07:05) is consistent with a non-worker, but the weekday pattern dominates.
